caption: The drawing depicts three ceramic vessels, each rendered in shades of gray and blue, with decorative blue flourishes. The central object is a tall, cylindrical crock with two looped side handles and a broad mouth, decorated with blue brushstroke patterns on its upper body. A wooden dasher or plunger with a smooth, brown surface is inserted upright in the mouth of the crock. Above and to the left is a smaller, squat vessel with a wide mouth, single looped handle, and blue floral or foliate decoration. To the upper right is a taller, narrower vessel with two small handles and similar blue decorative patterns. The drawing is executed on a cream-colored paper with the artist’s signature, "Yolande DeLasser," in the bottom right corner. The overall composition centers the large crock with dasher, with the two smaller vessels floating above it symmetrically.
title: Butter Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
